name: dear-dashboard
description: A read surface over the record. Reads the markdown in data/ at request time; no database. Runs on localhost under next dev, behind a login gate. Never hosted: it runs on her machine only.

scripts.build: node scripts/dashboard.mjs ensure-accounts && npm run check && npm run gen:theme && next build
scripts.check: node scripts/check-safety.mjs && node scripts/check-config.mjs && node scripts/check-privacy.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-perimeter.mjs && node scripts/check-record-paths.mjs && node scripts/sandbox.mjs check
